1	/**
2	 * Streaming Crypto Service - Mode selection and AES-256-CTR streaming encryption
3	 *
4	 * Media files above 256KB are encrypted with AES-256-CTR using streaming 1MB chunks,
5	 * which keeps memory bounded regardless of file size. CTR mode produces ciphertext
6	 * that supports random-access decryption for streaming media playback.
7	 *
8	 * Non-media files and small media files continue using AES-256-GCM via the
9	 * existing file-crypto.service.ts path.
10	 */
11

13	  generateFileKey,

29	  'audio/mp4',
30	  'audio/webm',

33	]);

name: Web E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Git ref to checkout (tag, branch, or SHA)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  web-e2e:
    name: Web E2E Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s

      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Configure Kubo CORS for browser-based recovery test
        run: |
          # Allow browser cross-origin requests to Kubo gateway (needed by recovery.html)
          docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs config --json API.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Origin '["*"]'
          docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs config --json API.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Methods '["GET","POST","OPTIONS"]'
          docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs config --json Gateway.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Origin '["*"]'
          docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs config --json Gateway.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Methods '["GET","POST","OPTIONS"]'
          # Restart Kubo to apply config (kill + Docker auto-restarts)
          docker restart $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0)
          # Wait for Kubo to be healthy again
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if docker exec $(docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0) ipfs id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Kubo ready with CORS configured"
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web-e2e exec playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Install mock-ipns-routing dependencies
        run: |
          cd tools/mock-ipns-routing
          npm install
          npm run build

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web build
        env:
          VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000

      - name: Create .env files for Web E2E
        run: |
          # Web app .env (for Vite dev server)
          echo "VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID=${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}" > apps/web/.env
          echo "VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000" >> apps/web/.env
          # API .env (for NestJS)
          echo "NODE_ENV=test" > apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PORT=5432" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_USERNAME=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PASSWORD=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "JWT_SECRET=e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_PROVIDER=local" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_PORT=6379" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Run Web E2E tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web-e2e test
        env:
          CI: true
          # Database configuration
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          # IPFS configuration
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          # API configuration
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          # IPNS delegated routing (mock service)
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          # Redis for BullMQ job scheduling
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          # Web app configuration (needed for Web3Auth initialization)
          VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID }}
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          # Test-login endpoint (bypasses Core Kit, uses deterministic keypair)
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          SDK_E2E_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          # Web3Auth test credentials (fallback if TEST_LOGIN_SECRET not set)
          WEB3AUTH_TEST_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.WEB3AUTH_TEST_EMAIL }}
          WEB3AUTH_TEST_OTP: ${{ secrets.WEB3AUTH_TEST_OTP }}

      - name: Upload Playwright report on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: |
            tests/web-e2e/playwright-report/
            tests/web-e2e/test-results/
          retention-days: 7

name: CI E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      web: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.web }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          base: ${{ (github.event.before != '' && github.event.before != '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' && github.event.before) || 'HEAD~1' }}
          filters: |
            web:
              - 'apps/web/**'
              - 'apps/api/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tests/web-e2e/**'
              - 'tools/mock-ipns-routing/**'
              - '.github/workflows/web-e2e.yml'
              - '.github/workflows/ci-e2e.yml'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'tests/vectors/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/desktop-e2e.yml'
              - '.github/workflows/ci-e2e.yml'

      - name: Summary
        run: |
          echo "Web changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.web }}"
          echo "Desktop changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}"

  web-e2e:
    name: Web E2E
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.web == 'true' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/web-e2e.yml
    secrets: inherit

  desktop-e2e:
    name: Desktop E2E
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/desktop-e2e.yml
    secrets: inherit

  retrigger-release-gate:
    name: Re-trigger Release Gate
    needs: [detect-changes, web-e2e, desktop-e2e]
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Re-run release gate on open release-please PR
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Find any open release-please PR
          PR_BRANCH=$(gh pr list --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --search "head:release-please" --state open --limit 1 \
            --json headRefName --jq '.[0].headRefName // empty')

          if [ -z "$PR_BRANCH" ]; then
            echo "No open release-please PR — nothing to re-trigger"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Found open release-please PR on branch: ${PR_BRANCH}"

          # Find the most recent completed release gate run for this branch
          RUN_ID=$(gh run list --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --workflow=release-gate.yml --branch="${PR_BRANCH}" \
            --limit 20 --json databaseId,status \
            --jq 'map(select(.status == "completed")) | .[0].databaseId // empty')

          if [ -z "$RUN_ID" ]; then
            echo "No completed release gate run found for ${PR_BRANCH} — nothing to re-trigger"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Re-running release gate (run ${RUN_ID}) so it verifies E2E against current main"
          gh run rerun "${RUN_ID}" --repo "${{ github.repository }}"

282	          fi

318	                exit 1
319	              elif [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
320	                LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA="$sha"
321	                LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION="$conclusion"
322	                LATEST_IN_RANGE_RUN_ID="$run_id"
323	                break
324	              else
325	                echo "Skipping run ${run_id} at ${sha} — tests were skipped (no desktop changes detected by workflow)"
326	              fi
327	            fi
328	          done <<EOF
329	          $RUNS
330	          EOF
331	
332	          if [ -z "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA" ]; then
333	            echo "::error::No Desktop E2E run found (with tests actually executed) for any commit in ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD. Desktop code changed but was never verified."
334	            exit 1
335	          fi
336	
337	          if [ "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
338	            echo "::error::Most recent Desktop E2E run in range (at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA}) did not succeed (conclusion: ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION})."
339	            exit 1
340	          fi
341	
342	          echo "Desktop E2E: passed (run ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_RUN_ID} at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA} with tests executed)"
343	
344	      - name: Skip Desktop E2E (no desktop changes)
345	        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--') && needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop != 'true'
346	        run: echo "No desktop-related changes since last release — skipping Desktop E2E gate"
347	
348	      - name: Summary
349	        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
350	        run: echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

file.content:
name: Release Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes Since Last Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.check.outputs.desktop || steps.release-check.outputs.desktop }}
      prev_tag: ${{ steps.check.outputs.prev_tag || steps.release-check.outputs.prev_tag }}
      is_release: ${{ steps.release-check.outputs.is_release }}
    steps:
      - name: Check if release PR
        id: release-check
        env:
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$HEAD_REF" == release-please--* ]]; then
            echo "is_release=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "is_release=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "desktop=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "prev_tag=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Not a release PR — skipping change detection"
          fi

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: steps.release-check.outputs.is_release == 'true'
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for desktop-related changes since last release
        if: steps.release-check.outputs.is_release == 'true'
        id: check
        run: |
          # Find the latest non-staging release tag (cipher-box-v* format)
          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'cipher-box-v*' --sort=-v:refname \
            | grep -v 'staging' \
            | head -1)
          # Fallback to legacy v* tags if no cipher-box-v* tags exist
          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname \
              | grep -v 'staging' \
              | grep -v '@' \
              | head -1)
          fi

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No previous release tag found — assuming desktop changed"
            echo "desktop=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "prev_tag=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Previous release tag: ${PREV_TAG}"
          echo "prev_tag=${PREV_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          # Use origin/main (not HEAD) so that gh-run-rerun'd workflows
          # compare against the current main, not a stale GITHUB_SHA.
          git fetch origin main
          MAIN_REF="origin/main"
          echo "Diffing ${PREV_TAG}..${MAIN_REF}"

          # Desktop-related path patterns (mirrored from ci-e2e.yml)
          DESKTOP_PATTERNS=(
            'apps/desktop/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
            'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
            'apps/desktop/index.html'
            'apps/desktop/vite.config.'
            'apps/desktop/tsconfig'
            'crates/'
            'Cargo.toml'
            'Cargo.lock'
            'tests/vectors/'
            'packages/crypto/src/'
            'packages/crypto/tsconfig'
            '.github/workflows/desktop-e2e.yml'
            '.github/workflows/ci-e2e.yml'
          )

          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "${PREV_TAG}..${MAIN_REF}")
          DESKTOP_CHANGED=false

          for pattern in "${DESKTOP_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Fq "$pattern"; then
              echo "Desktop change detected matching pattern: ${pattern}"
              DESKTOP_CHANGED=true
              break
            fi
          done

          echo "desktop=${DESKTOP_CHANGED}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Desktop changes detected: ${DESKTOP_CHANGED}"

  verify-e2e:
    name: Verify E2E Passed
    needs: detect-changes
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - name: Fail if detect-changes did not complete (release PR)
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--') && needs.detect-changes.result != 'success'
        run: |
          echo "::error::detect-changes must succeed before E2E verification."
          exit 1

      - name: Skip (not a release PR)
        if: "!startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')"
        run: echo "Not a release PR — E2E gate not applicable"

      - name: Wait for Web E2E and verify it passed
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the latest commit on main (the base the release PR targets)
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Latest main commit: ${MAIN_SHA}"

          # Poll for the CI E2E orchestrator run to complete (it triggers on the same push)
          # 40 * 30s = 20 min — matches the web-e2e.yml job timeout
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
          POLL_INTERVAL=30
          echo "Waiting for CI E2E run to complete (polling every ${POLL_INTERVAL}s, max ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts)..."

          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            E2E_CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=ci-e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
              --json headSha,conclusion,status,databaseId \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].conclusion // empty")

            if [ -n "$E2E_CONCLUSION" ]; then
              echo "CI E2E completed with conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION}"

              # Grab the run ID for job-level checks below
              E2E_RUN_ID=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
                --workflow=ci-e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=10 \
                --json headSha,databaseId \
                --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0].databaseId")
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
              echo "::error::CI E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes for main (${MAIN_SHA})."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: CI E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
            sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
          done

          if [ "$E2E_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::CI E2E orchestrator did not pass on main (conclusion: ${E2E_CONCLUSION})"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Verify the Web E2E job actually ran (not skipped due to no web changes).
          # When ci-e2e.yml calls web-e2e.yml via workflow_call, the job name is
          # composed as "Web E2E / Web E2E Tests" — contains("Web E2E") matches both.
          if ! WEB_E2E_RAN=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${E2E_RUN_ID}/jobs" \
            --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name | contains("Web E2E")) | select(.conclusion == "success")] | length'); then
            echo "::error::Failed to query jobs for CI E2E run ${E2E_RUN_ID} (API error)"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "${WEB_E2E_RAN:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "CI E2E passed but Web E2E was skipped (no web changes in latest push)."
            echo "Searching for most recent CI E2E run where Web E2E actually executed..."

            RECENT_RUN_ID=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
              --workflow=ci-e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=20 \
              --json databaseId,conclusion,status \
              --jq '[.[] | select(.status == "completed" and .conclusion == "success")] | .[].databaseId' \
              | while read -r rid; do
                  if ! WEB_COUNT=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${rid}/jobs" \
                    --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name | contains("Web E2E")) | select(.conclusion == "success")] | length'); then
                    echo "::warning::Failed to query jobs for run ${rid}, skipping" >&2
                    continue
                  fi
                  if [ "${WEB_COUNT:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
                    echo "$rid"
                    break
                  fi
                done)

            if [ -z "$RECENT_RUN_ID" ]; then
              echo "::error::No recent CI E2E run found where Web E2E tests actually executed."
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Web E2E: passed (in CI E2E run ${RECENT_RUN_ID})"
          else
            echo "Web E2E: passed (at HEAD)"
          fi

      - name: Verify Desktop E2E (if desktop changed)
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--') && needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PREV_TAG: ${{ needs.detect-changes.outputs.prev_tag }}
        run: |
          MAIN_SHA=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Desktop changes detected since ${PREV_TAG} — verifying Desktop E2E"

          # Helper: check if a workflow run actually executed desktop-e2e jobs
          # (not skipped due to change detection). Returns 0 if tests ran, 1 if skipped, 2 on API error.
          run_executed_tests() {
            local run_id=$1
            local executed
            if ! executed=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${run_id}/jobs" \
              --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name | startswith("Desktop E2E")) | select(.conclusion == "success")] | length'); then
              echo "::error::Failed to query jobs for run ${run_id} (API error or rate limit)"
              return 2
            fi
            [ "${executed:-0}" -gt 0 ]
          }

          # First check if there's a desktop E2E run for HEAD (may still be running)
          HEAD_RUN=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=ci-e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=50 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status,databaseId \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.headSha == \"${MAIN_SHA}\")][0]")

          HEAD_STATUS=$(echo "$HEAD_RUN" | jq -r '.status // empty')

          if [ -n "$HEAD_STATUS" ]; then
            HEAD_RUN_ID=$(echo "$HEAD_RUN" | jq -r '.databaseId')
            echo "Desktop E2E run exists for HEAD (run ${HEAD_RUN_ID}) — polling until complete..."
            MAX_ATTEMPTS=40
            POLL_INTERVAL=30

            for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
              CONCLUSION=$(gh run view "$HEAD_RUN_ID" --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
                --json conclusion \
                --jq '.conclusion // empty')

              if [ -n "$CONCLUSION" ]; then
                if [ "$CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
                  echo "::error::Desktop E2E Tests did not pass on main (conclusion: ${CONCLUSION})"
                  exit 1
                fi
                # Verify the desktop-e2e jobs actually ran (not skipped)
                run_executed_tests "$HEAD_RUN_ID" && rc=0 || rc=$?
                if [ "$rc" -eq 2 ]; then
                  exit 1
                elif [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
                  echo "Desktop E2E: passed (at HEAD, tests executed)"
                  exit 0
                else
                  echo "Desktop E2E run at HEAD succeeded but tests were skipped (no desktop changes detected by workflow)."
                  echo "Falling through to search for a run that actually executed tests..."
                  break
                fi
              fi

              if [ "$attempt" -eq "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
                echo "::error::Desktop E2E run did not complete within $(( MAX_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL / 60 )) minutes."
                exit 1
              fi

              echo "Attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS}: Desktop E2E still running, waiting ${POLL_INTERVAL}s..."
              sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
            done
          fi

          # No desktop E2E run for HEAD (or HEAD run skipped tests) — find the
          # most recent run in the release range that actually executed tests
          echo "Searching for a Desktop E2E run that executed tests since ${PREV_TAG}..."

          if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
            echo "::error::No previous release tag and no Desktop E2E run for HEAD. Cannot verify desktop changes."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Get commit SHAs in the release range
          RANGE_COMMITS=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/compare/${PREV_TAG}...${MAIN_SHA}" \
            --jq '[.commits[].sha] | join("\n")' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          if [ -z "$RANGE_COMMITS" ]; then
            echo "::error::Could not determine commits in range ${PREV_TAG}..${MAIN_SHA}"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Get recent completed CI E2E orchestrator runs (newest first) and find
          # the most recent one whose commit is within the release range AND whose
          # Desktop E2E jobs actually ran (not skipped due to no desktop changes)
          RUNS=$(gh run list --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --workflow=ci-e2e.yml --branch=main --limit=50 \
            --json headSha,conclusion,status,databaseId \
            --jq '.[] | select(.status == "completed") | "\(.headSha) \(.conclusion) \(.databaseId)"')

          LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA=""
          LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION=""

          while IFS=" " read -r sha conclusion run_id; do
            if [ -z "$sha" ]; then
              continue
            fi
            if echo "$RANGE_COMMITS" | grep -Fq "$sha"; then
              if [ "$conclusion" != "success" ]; then
                # Found a failed run in range — report it immediately
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA="$sha"
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION="$conclusion"
                break
              fi
              # Success run — verify tests actually executed
              run_executed_tests "$run_id" && rc=0 || rc=$?
              if [ "$rc" -eq 2 ]; then
                exit 1
              elif [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA="$sha"
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION="$conclusion"
                LATEST_IN_RANGE_RUN_ID="$run_id"
                break
              else
                echo "Skipping run ${run_id} at ${sha} — tests were skipped (no desktop changes detected by workflow)"
              fi
            fi
          done <<EOF
          $RUNS
          EOF

          if [ -z "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::No Desktop E2E run found (with tests actually executed) for any commit in ${PREV_TAG}..HEAD. Desktop code changed but was never verified."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Most recent Desktop E2E run in range (at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA}) did not succeed (conclusion: ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_CONCLUSION})."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Desktop E2E: passed (run ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_RUN_ID} at ${LATEST_IN_RANGE_SHA} with tests executed)"

      - name: Skip Desktop E2E (no desktop changes)
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--') && needs.detect-changes.outputs.desktop != 'true'
        run: echo "No desktop-related changes since last release — skipping Desktop E2E gate"

      - name: Summary
        if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-please--')
        run: echo "All E2E gates passed — release is safe to merge."

## Root cause analysis

**batch-download (login crash):** The `page.waitForURL` fails with "Target page, context or browser has been closed" during `loginViaWallet` in `beforeAll`. In CI headless Chrome, the SW may not have claimed the page by the time the preview opens. cargo-windows:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-macos:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-linux:
    name: Cargo Check, Test & Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Cargo test with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --workspace
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  vector-parity:
    name: Cross-Language Vector Parity
    needs: [changes, cargo-linux, test]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse3-dev pkg-config build-essential \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev libxdo-dev

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build TypeScript packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build && pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build

      - name: Run Rust vector tests
        run: cargo test -p cipherbox-crypto --test cross_language --no-default-features

      - name: Run TypeScript vector tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test -- --reporter=verbose

      - name: Check vector parity
        run: bash scripts/check-vector-parity.sh

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'

              - 'tests/vectors/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          # Compare openapi.json semantically (ignore formatting differences from prettier versions)
          if ! node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const {execSync} = require('child_process');
            const committed = JSON.parse(execSync('git show HEAD:packages/api-client/openapi.json', {encoding:'utf8'}));
            const generated = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/api-client/openapi.json', 'utf8'));
            if (JSON.stringify(committed) !== JSON.stringify(generated)) {
              console.error('openapi.json schema has changed');
              process.exit(1);
            }
          "; then
            echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Compare generated TS files exactly
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/src/generated/ packages/api-client/src/models/ \
            || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:

    needs: [changes, lint]

    steps:

      - name: Install dependencies

      - name: Build packages (needed for cross-package imports in tests)

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage

      - name: Run SDK-Core tests with coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov

        with:

          flags: api,crypto,core,sdk-core,sdk,api-client

      - name: Cache coverage for base branch upload

  sdk-e2e:
    name: SDK E2E Tests
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:

    steps:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

      - name: Install dependencies

      - name: Build packages
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      - name: Create API .env
        run: |
          echo "NODE_ENV=test" > apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PORT=5432" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_USERNAME=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PASSWORD=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "JWT_SECRET=e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_PROVIDER=local" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_PORT=6379" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDACTED" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        run: |
          cd tools/mock-ipns-routing
          node dist/server.js &
          sleep 2

      - name: Start API server
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api start:prod &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do

              break
            fi

          done
          if ! curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then

        env:

          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-windows:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-macos:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-linux:
    name: Cargo Check, Test & Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Cargo test with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --workspace
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  vector-parity:
    name: Cross-Language Vector Parity
    needs: [changes, cargo-linux, test]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse3-dev pkg-config build-essential \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev libxdo-dev

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build TypeScript packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build && pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build

      - name: Run Rust vector tests
        run: cargo test -p cipherbox-crypto --test cross_language --no-default-features

      - name: Run TypeScript vector tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test -- --reporter=verbose

      - name: Check vector parity
        run: bash scripts/check-vector-parity.sh

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:

        ports:

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |

      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:

            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)

          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

    steps:

        with:

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:

        run: |

          if ! node -e "

            const {execSync} = require('child_process');
            const committed = JSON.parse(execSync('git show HEAD:packages/api-client/openapi.json', {encoding:'utf8'}));

            if (JSON.stringify(committed) !== JSON.stringify(generated)) {
              console.error('openapi.json schema has changed');
              process.exit(1);
            }
          "; then
            echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Compare generated TS files exactly
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/src/generated/ packages/api-client/src/models/ \
            || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres

          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          # Compare openapi.json semantically (ignore formatting differences from prettier versions)
          if ! node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const {execSync} = require('child_process');
            const committed = JSON.parse(execSync('git show HEAD:packages/api-client/openapi.json', {encoding:'utf8'}));
            const generated = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/api-client/openapi.json', 'utf8'));
            if (JSON.stringify(committed) !== JSON.stringify(generated)) {
              console.error('openapi.json schema has changed');
              process.exit(1);
            }
          "; then
            echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Compare generated TS files exactly
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/src/generated/ packages/api-client/src/models/ \
            || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          # Compare openapi.json semantically (ignore formatting differences from prettier versions)
          if ! node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const {execSync} = require('child_process');
            const committed = JSON.parse(execSync('git show HEAD:packages/api-client/openapi.json', {encoding:'utf8'}));
            const generated = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/api-client/openapi.json', 'utf8'));
            if (JSON.stringify(committed) !== JSON.stringify(generated)) {
              console.error('openapi.json schema has changed');
              process.exit(1);
            }
          "; then
            echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Compare generated TS files exactly
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/src/generated/ packages/api-client/src/models/ \
            || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine

        ports:

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage

  sdk-e2e:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing

          REDIS_HOST: localhost
