  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-windows:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-macos:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-linux:
    name: Cargo Check, Test & Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Cargo test with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --workspace
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  vector-parity:
    name: Cross-Language Vector Parity
    needs: [changes, cargo-linux, test]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse3-dev pkg-config build-essential \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev libxdo-dev

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build TypeScript packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build && pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build

      - name: Run Rust vector tests
        run: cargo test -p cipherbox-crypto --test cross_language --no-default-features

      - name: Run TypeScript vector tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test -- --reporter=verbose

      - name: Check vector parity
        run: bash scripts/check-vector-parity.sh

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
      rust: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.rust }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'tests/vectors/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'
            rust:
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'tests/vectors/**'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          # Compare openapi.json semantically (ignore formatting differences from prettier versions)
          if ! node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const {execSync} = require('child_process');
            const committed = JSON.parse(execSync('git show HEAD:packages/api-client/openapi.json', {encoding:'utf8'}));
            const generated = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/api-client/openapi.json', 'utf8'));
            if (JSON.stringify(committed) !== JSON.stringify(generated)) {
              console.error('openapi.json schema has changed');
              process.exit(1);
            }
          "; then
            echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Compare generated TS files exactly
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/src/generated/ packages/api-client/src/models/ \
            || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (needed for cross-package imports in tests)
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Run Core tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core test:coverage

      - name: Run SDK-Core tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core test:coverage

      - name: Run SDK tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk test:coverage

      - name: Run API Client tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/core/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/sdk-core/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/sdk/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/api-client/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto,core,sdk-core,sdk,api-client
          fail_ci_if_error: false

      - name: Cache coverage for base branch upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-lcov
          path: |
            apps/api/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/core/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/sdk-core/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/sdk/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/api-client/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 7

  sdk-e2e:
    name: SDK E2E Tests
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s

      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install mock-ipns-routing
        run: |
          cd tools/mock-ipns-routing
          npm install
          npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      - name: Create API .env
        run: |
          echo "NODE_ENV=test" > apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PORT=5432" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_USERNAME=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PASSWORD=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "JWT_SECRET=e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_PROVIDER=local" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDIS_PORT=6379" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "REDACTED" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        run: |
          cd tools/mock-ipns-routing
          node dist/server.js &
          sleep 2

      - name: Start API server
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api start:prod &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API is ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if ! curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "API failed to start within 30s"
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run SDK E2E tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-e2e test
        env:
          SDK_E2E_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          SDK_E2E_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET: ci-throttle-bypass-secret

  build:

  cargo-windows:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-macos:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-linux:
    name: Cargo Check, Test & Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |

    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:

        run: rustup default stable

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Build TypeScript packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build && pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build

      - name: Run Rust vector tests

      - name: Run TypeScript vector tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test -- --reporter=verbose

      - name: Check vector parity
        run: bash scripts/check-vector-parity.sh

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'tests/vectors/**'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          # Compare openapi.json semantically (ignore formatting differences from prettier versions)
          if ! node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const {execSync} = require('child_process');
            const committed = JSON.parse(execSync('git show HEAD:packages/api-client/openapi.json', {encoding:'utf8'}));
            const generated = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/api-client/openapi.json', 'utf8'));
            if (JSON.stringify(committed) !== JSON.stringify(generated)) {
              console.error('openapi.json schema has changed');
              process.exit(1);
            }
          "; then
            echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Compare generated TS files exactly
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/src/generated/ packages/api-client/src/models/ \
            || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (needed for cross-package imports in tests)
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Run Core tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core test:coverage

      - name: Run SDK-Core tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core test:coverage

      - name: Run SDK tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk test:coverage

      - name: Run API Client tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/core/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/sdk-core/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/sdk/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/api-client/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto,core,sdk-core,sdk,api-client
          fail_ci_if_error: false

      - name: Cache coverage for base branch upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-lcov
          path: |
            apps/api/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/core/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/sdk-core/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/sdk/coverage/lcov.info
            packages/api-client/coverage/lcov.info

  sdk-e2e:
    name: SDK E2E Tests
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-

    steps:

        with:

          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      - name: Create API .env
        run: |
          echo "NODE_ENV=test" > apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_HOST=localhost" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PORT=5432" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_USERNAME=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_PASSWORD=postgres" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "JWT_SECRET=e2e-test-jwt-secret-key-for-ci" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173" >> apps/api/.env
          echo "IPFS_PROVIDER=local" >> apps/api/.env

    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |

    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:

        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob

        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

        run: |

      - name: Cargo test with coverage
        run: >-

          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:

    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:

            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev libxdo-dev

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

## Summary
- **E2E beforeAll timeout**: The default 30s `beforeAll` hook timeout was too short for wallet login in CI. Added `test.setTimeout(120_000)` to batch-download and streaming-playback `beforeAll` hooks.
- **batch-download download test**: Replaced `Escape` key (unreliable after download) with `selectionBar.clickClear()` to dismiss the selection bar.
- **CI optimization**: Narrowed the `desktop` change filter to only Rust-relevant paths — cargo check/test jobs no longer run for TypeScript-only desktop frontend changes.

## Root cause
The "page closed" errors were caused by Playwright's 30s default `beforeAll` timeout killing the hook mid-login. The wallet login takes >30s in CI (Core Kit init + DKG). When the hook is killed, the browser context is torn down, and pending `page.waitForURL` calls fail with "Target page, context or browser has been closed".

## Release-gate note
The release-gate "Verify E2E Passed" job is stuck because the release-please PR branch references the old `--workflow=e2e.yml` (renamed to `ci-e2e.yml` in #396). Once this PR merges and release-please rebases, the release-gate will use the correct workflow name.

## Test plan
- [ ] CI Web E2E passes (batch-download login + download, streaming-playback login)
- [ ] Cargo jobs skip for TypeScript-only PR changes
- [ ] Release-gate detects E2E results after release-please PR rebases

# E2E Test Debugging Workflow

**Date:** 2026-03-29
**Context:** Debugging batch-download and streaming-playback E2E test failures in CI

## Key Lessons

### Never blindly commit E2E fixes and wait for CI

CI round-trips take 15-20 minutes per iteration. Blindly pushing fixes and waiting for CI is extremely inefficient. Always reproduce failures locally first.

### Local reproduction approach

1. **Run against staging first:** The default Playwright `webServer` config often doesn't work locally (services may be misconfigured, mock wallet may not render). Instead, run tests against the staging environment:
   ```bash
   BASE_URL=https://app-staging.cipherbox.cc pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web-e2e exec playwright test tests/<file>.spec.ts --timeout 180000
   ```

2. **If staging isn't available:** Start API and web app manually before running tests (don't rely on Playwright's `webServer` auto-start):
   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api dev &
   pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web dev &
   # Wait for both to be ready, then run tests
   ```

3. **Only commit after tests pass locally/staging.**

### Playwright beforeAll hook timeout

- `test.setTimeout()` at describe level only sets **test** timeouts, NOT hook timeouts
- `beforeAll`/`afterAll` hooks default to **30 seconds** regardless of `test.setTimeout()`
- To extend hook timeout: call `test.setTimeout(N)` **inside** the hook body
- When a hook times out, Playwright tears down the browser context — any pending `page.waitForURL` etc. fails with "Target page, context or browser has been closed", which looks like a crash but is just a timeout

### Escape key unreliable for UI dismissal in E2E

- `page.keyboard.press('Escape')` is unreliable for dismissing selection bars after certain operations (e.g., batch download)
- Prefer explicit UI actions like `selectionBar.clickClear()` over keyboard shortcuts
- CI headless Chrome handles keyboard events differently than headed browsers

### Soft assertions for environment-dependent features

- CTR streaming badge depends on: SW active + file encrypted with CTR + metadata resolution
- This pipeline may not work in all environments (staging deploys may be behind, Vite dev mode SW quirks)
- Use soft assertions (try/catch with timeout) for features that depend on the full pipeline
- Don't let environment-specific issues break the entire test suite

content.text:
# Resolve PR Review Comments

Resolve all open review comments on the current PR from any automated reviewer (CodeRabbit, GitHub Copilot, etc.) or human reviewers.

## Workflow

### 1. Identify the PR

```bash
PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr view --json number --jq '.number')
```

If no PR exists for the current branch, stop and inform the user.

### 2. Fetch all unresolved review threads

Use the GraphQL `reviewThreads` query to get threads with `isResolved` status:

```bash
REPO_OWNER=$(gh repo view --json owner --jq '.owner.login')
REPO_NAME=$(gh repo view --json name --jq '.name')

gh api graphql -f query="
{
  repository(owner: \"$REPO_OWNER\", name: \"$REPO_NAME\") {
    pullRequest(number: $PR_NUMBER) {
      reviewThreads(first: 100) {
        nodes {
          id
          isResolved
          comments(first: 10) {
            nodes {
              id
              author { login }
              body
              path
              line
              createdAt
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}"
```

Filter to only unresolved threads. If none, report "No unresolved review threads" and stop.

### 3. Triage each comment

For each unresolved thread, read the comment and the referenced code. Categorize as:

- **Valid fix needed** — the comment identifies a real bug, security issue, or meaningful improvement
- **Already addressed** — the issue was fixed in a later commit on this branch
- **Not applicable** — the suggestion doesn't apply (explain why)

### 4. Implement fixes

For all "valid fix needed" comments:

1. Read the referenced file and understand the context
2. Implement the fix
3. Track which thread the fix addresses

Do NOT:

- Make unrelated changes or refactors
- Add features beyond what the comment requests
- Increase timeouts or add retries as a first approach — fix root causes

### 5. Run tests locally

After ALL fixes are implemented:

```bash
# Type check
pnpm typecheck

# Run relevant unit tests
pnpm test

# If E2E-relevant changes were made, run E2E tests too
cd tests/web-e2e && pnpm exec playwright test
```

Do NOT proceed to commit until tests pass. If tests fail, fix the failures first.

### 6. Commit and push

```bash
git add <specific-files>
git commit -m "fix: address PR review comments"
git push
```

### 7. Reply to and resolve each thread

For each thread, reply explaining what was done, then resolve:

- **Fixed comments**: Reply with what was changed and where, then resolve
- **Already addressed**: Reply explaining which commit addressed it, then resolve
- **Not applicable**: Reply with clear reasoning for not making changes, then resolve

Reply via REST (use `--field` not `-f` for `in_reply_to` — must be integer):

```bash
gh api repos/$REPO_OWNER/$REPO_NAME/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/comments \
  --field in_reply_to=COMMENT_ID \
  --raw-field body='...'
```

Resolve via GraphQL (can batch multiple):

```bash
gh api graphql -f query='
mutation {
  resolveReviewThread(input: {threadId: "THREAD_ID"}) {
    thread { isResolved }
  }
}'
```

### 8. Report summary

Print a summary table:

- Thread count resolved
- Fixes made (with file:line references)
- Comments marked as already addressed or not applicable

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'tests/vectors/**'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.40.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          # Compare openapi.json semantically (ignore formatting differences from prettier versions)
          if ! node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const {execSync} = require('child_process');
            const committed = JSON.parse(execSync('git show HEAD:packages/api-client/openapi.json', {encoding:'utf8'}));
            const generated = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/api-client/openapi.json', 'utf8'));
            if (JSON.stringify(committed) !== JSON.stringify(generated)) {
              console.error('openapi.json schema has changed');
              process.exit(1);
            }
          "; then
            echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Compare generated TS files exactly
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/src/generated/ packages/api-client/src/models/ \
            || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api-client build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-windows:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-macos:
    name: Cargo Check & Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Cargo test (workspace)
        run: cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-linux:
    name: Cargo Check, Test & Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check (workspace)
        run: cargo check --workspace --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        run: |
          rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
          cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked

      - name: Cargo test with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --workspace
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  vector-parity:
    name: Cross-Language Vector Parity
    needs: [changes, cargo-linux, test]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse3-dev pkg-config build-essential \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev libxdo-dev

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build TypeScript packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build && pnpm --filter @cipherbox/core build

      - name: Run Rust vector tests
        run: cargo test -p cipherbox-crypto --test cross_language --no-default-features

      - name: Run TypeScript vector tests
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test -- --reporter=verbose

      - name: Check vector parity
        run: bash scripts/check-vector-parity.sh

content.text:
Found it. The console shows:

```
The path of the provided scope ('/') is not under the max scope allowed...Service-Worker-Allowed HTTP header to allow the scope.
[SW] Registration failed
```

**This is a real bug.** The Service Worker registration fails in Vite dev mode because the SW is served from `/src/workers/decrypt-sw.ts` but registered with `scope: '/'`. The browser requires a `Service-Worker-Allowed` header to allow a broader scope. Without it, the SW never activates, `isStreaming` is always false, and the CTR badge never appears.

Let me fix the actual bug in the Vite config.

The fix is to add a `Service-Worker-Allowed` header for the SW file. I can do this either as a global header or via middleware. The cleanest approach is a Vite plugin that adds the header only for the SW path.

Perfect! Now I have a complete picture. Let me create a comprehensive document tracing the flow:

## File Upload Flow Trace Report

I've successfully traced the complete file upload flow in the cipher-box web app. Here's the comprehensive breakdown:

---

## 1. ENTRY POINT: UploadZone Component

**File:** `/Users/michael/Code/cipher-box/apps/web/src/components/file-browser/UploadZone.tsx`

When a user drops files on the UploadZone component, the flow begins:

```
User drops files
    ↓
<UploadZone /> component
    ↓
react-dropzone onDrop callback
    ↓
handleDrop() (lines 36-61)
    ↓
calls handleFileDrop() from useDropUpload hook (line 55)
```

**Key component methods:**
- `handleDrop()` - uses `react-dropzone` to capture drop events
- Validates rejected files (too large)
- Calls `handleFileDrop(acceptedFiles, folderId)` from the `useDropUpload` hook

---

## 2. ORCHESTRATION HOOK: useDropUpload

**File:** `/Users/michael/Code/cipher-box/apps/web/src/hooks/useDropUpload.ts`

This is the **core orchestration hook** that manages the entire upload flow for both new and duplicate files.

### What `handleFileDrop()` does (lines 33-220):

**Pre-upload validation:**
- Checks file size (max 100MB per FILE-01)
- Checks storage quota
- Detects duplicate filenames in batch
- Identifies file-folder name collisions
- Identifies existing files (duplicates) vs new files

**For NEW files (lines 117-137):**
```
Uses SDK's client.uploadFile()
    ↓
Atomic encrypt → upload → register operation
    ↓
Returns cid and tracks in uploadedCids
```

**For DUPLICATE files (lines 144-189):**
```
Hoists imports (lines 147-149):
    - encryptFile from services/file-crypto.service
    - addToIpfs from lib/api/ipfs

For each duplicate file:
    1. Call encryptFile(file, userPublicKey)
    2. Upload encrypted blob to IPFS via addToIpfs()
    3. Store in pendingReplacements array
    4. Include encryptionMode in metadata
```

**Store mutations:**
- `uploadStore.startUpload(files.length)` - starts tracking
- `uploadStore.setUploading(file.name, percent)` - progress updates
- `uploadStore.fileComplete()` - increment completed count
- `uploadStore.setPendingReplacements()` - surface duplicates for user decision

---

## 3. ENCRYPTION SERVICE: file-crypto.service

**File:** `/Users/michael/Code/cipher-box/apps/web/src/services/file-crypto.service.ts`

This is the **function that encrypts files** and determines encryption mode:

```typescript
export async function encryptFile(
  file: File,
  userPublicKey: Uint8Array
): Promise<EncryptedFileResult>
```

### Encryption Mode Selection:

**Calls `selectEncryptionMode(file)`** from `streaming-crypto.service.ts` (line 38):

```typescript
function selectEncryptionMode(file: File): 'GCM' | 'CTR' {
  if (STREAMING_MIME_TYPES.has(file.type) && file.size > CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD) {
    return 'CTR';  // Media files > 256KB
  }
  return 'GCM';    // All other files or small media
}
```

### Encryption Paths:

**CTR Path (lines 41-42):** Media files > 256KB
```
Call encryptFileCtr(file, userPublicKey)
    ↓
Streaming 1MB chunks with AES-256-CTR
    ↓
Returns ciphertext with encryptionMode: 'CTR'
```

**GCM Path (lines 46-70):** All other files
```
1. generateFileKey()
2. generateIv()
3. Read file as Uint8Array
4. encryptAesGcm(plaintext, fileKey, iv)
5. wrapKey(fileKey, userPublicKey) - ECIES wrapping
6. clearBytes(fileKey) - memory cleanup
7. Return with encryptionMode: 'GCM'
```

### Return Type:

```typescript
{
  ciphertext: Uint8Array,
  iv: string,              // hex-encoded
  wrappedKey: string,      // hex-encoded
  originalSize: number,
  encryptedSize: number,
  encryptionMode: 'GCM' | 'CTR'  // <-- SET HERE
}
```

---

## 4. WHERE ENCRYPTION MODE IS SET

There are **THREE places** where `encryptionMode` is set:

### **PLACE 1: file-crypto.service.ts**
- Lines 69 & 141 set it to 'GCM' or 'CTR' based on mode selection
- Returns in `EncryptedFileResult`

### **PLACE 2: useDropUpload.ts (duplicate files)**
- Line 185: `encryptionMode: encrypted.encryptionMode`
- Captured from `encryptFile()` result
- Stored in `PendingReplacement.encryptedData`

### **PLACE 3: ReplaceFileDialog.tsx**
- Line 47: `newEncryptionMode: current.encryptedData.encryptionMode`
- Passes from pending replacement to `updateFile()` operation

---

## 5. COMPLETE FLOW CHAIN (Duplicate Files Path)

This is the **FULL PATH** from drop to encryption:

```
User drops file "photo.mp4"
    ↓
UploadZone.handleDrop()
    ↓
useDropUpload.handleFileDrop(acceptedFiles, folderId)
    ↓
Detects duplicate filename
    ↓
Import encryptFile & addToIpfs (hoisted, lines 147-149)
    ↓
encryptFile(file, userPublicKey)  [file-crypto.service.ts:34]
    ↓
selectEncryptionMode(file)  [streaming-crypto.service.ts:53]
    ├─ Media type? > 256KB?
    ├─ YES → return 'CTR'
    └─ NO → return 'GCM'
    ↓
If CTR: encryptFileCtr() → streaming chunks
If GCM: generateFileKey() → encryptAesGcm() → wrapKey()
    ↓
Return EncryptedFileResult with encryptionMode: 'CTR' | 'GCM'
    ↓
createBlob(new Uint8Array(encrypted.ciphertext))
    ↓
addToIpfs(blob) → { cid: string }
    ↓
Store PendingReplacement with:
  - cid
  - wrappedKey (from encryptFile)
  - iv (from encryptFile)
  - encryptionMode (from encryptFile) ← SET HERE
    ↓
uploadStore.setPendingReplacements([replacement])
    ↓
ReplaceFileDialog rendered
    ↓
User clicks Replace
    ↓
updateFile(parentId, {
  newEncryptionMode: replacement.encryptedData.encryptionMode
})
```

---

## 6. NEW FILES PATH (SDK Flow)

For new files, the flow uses SDK's `client.uploadFile()`:

```
useDropUpload.handleFileDrop()
    ↓
client.uploadFile(
  parentFolder.ipnsName,
  data,
  file.name,
  file.type,
  progress callback
)  [packages/sdk/src/client.ts:657]
    ↓
sdkCore.uploadFile({
  data,
  fileId,
  mimeType,
  folderKey,
  userPublicKey,  ← Encryption mode selection happens here
  ...
})
    ↓
Handles both GCM and CTR internally
    ↓
Returns { cid, fileMetaIpnsName }
    ↓
SDK registers in folder metadata
```

---

## 7. KEY FILES AND THEIR ROLES

| File | Purpose | Key Function |
|------|---------|--------------|
| `UploadZone.tsx` | UI component | Captures drop events via react-dropzone |
| `useDropUpload.ts` | Orchestration | Manages file validation, duplication detection, encryption flow |
| `file-crypto.service.ts` | Encryption | `encryptFile()` - main encryption entry point, returns with mode |
| `streaming-crypto.service.ts` | Mode selection | `selectEncryptionMode()` & `encryptFileCtr()` for large media |
| `upload.service.ts` | Legacy service | Used by `useFileUpload` hook (deprecated path) |
| `upload.store.ts` | State management | Zustand store tracking status, progress, pending replacements |
| `ReplaceFileDialog.tsx` | User decision | Surfaces duplicates, passes encryption mode to `updateFile()` |

---

## 8. SUMMARY: The Three Questions Answered

### **Q1: When a user drops a file on UploadZone, what function handles it?**
**A:** `useDropUpload.handleFileDrop()` (line 33 in `/apps/web/src/hooks/useDropUpload.ts`)

### **Q2: How does that function eventually call encryptFile?**
**A:** For duplicate files:
- Lines 147-149: Import `encryptFile` from `file-crypto.service`
- Line 162: Call `encryptFile(file, userPublicKey)`
- For new files: SDK's `client.uploadFile()` handles encryption internally

### **Q3: Where is encryptionMode set during upload?**
**A:** Three locations:
1. **file-crypto.service.ts** (lines 69 & 141): Set when `encryptFile()` returns
2. **useDropUpload.ts** (line 185): Captured into `PendingReplacement.encryptedData.encryptionMode`
3. **ReplaceFileDialog.tsx** (line 47): Passed as `newEncryptionMode` to file update operation

The mode is determined by `selectEncryptionMode()` in `streaming-crypto.service.ts`: if file is media + > 256KB, use 'CTR'; otherwise use 'GCM'.

Here's the situation:

**Root cause:** The SDK's `uploadFile()` in `packages/sdk-core/src/upload/index.ts` hardcodes `encryptAesGcm` (line 88) and `encryptionMode: 'GCM'` (line 113). The `selectEncryptionMode` function exists in the web app's `streaming-crypto.service.ts` but is only called for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path — never for new uploads through the SDK.

**Two separate bugs found:**
1. **SW registration fails in Vite dev mode** — fixed with the `public/decrypt-sw-dev.js` wrapper
2. **SDK upload always uses GCM** — the CTR encryption mode selection (`selectEncryptionMode`) was never wired into the SDK upload pipeline

**What needs to happen for the CTR badge test to pass:**
- The SDK's `uploadFile` needs to accept an `encryptionMode` parameter and, when CTR, use `encryptAesCtr` instead of `encryptAesGcm`
- The caller (either the SDK client or the web app's upload hook) needs to determine the mode based on MIME type and size

This is a feature bug, not a test bug. The E2E test correctly caught that CTR streaming doesn't work for new uploads. How would you like to proceed — fix the SDK upload pipeline now, or scope the CTR badge test as a known skip and track the SDK fix separately?

input.args: SDK uploadFile() hardcodes GCM encryption — CTR streaming never triggers for new uploads. The SDK's uploadFile() in packages/sdk-core/src/upload/index.ts always uses encryptAesGcm (line 88) and sets encryptionMode: 'GCM' (line 113). The selectEncryptionMode() function in apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts is only used for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path. Fix: add encryptionMode param to sdkCore.uploadFile() and client.uploadFile(), use encryptAesCtr when mode is CTR, determine mode based on MIME type + size (>256KB media → CTR). The @cipherbox/crypto package already exports encryptAesCtr.

## Problem

The AES-CTR streaming encryption/decryption system has 35 unit tests in `packages/crypto` but zero E2E coverage. The full pipeline — mode selection, Service Worker interception, range-request decryption, seeking — has never been tested end-to-end. Phase 12.1 left a human verification checklist that was never automated.

Key behaviors untested at E2E level:

- CTR mode selected for media >256KB (vs GCM for smaller/non-media files)
- Service Worker intercepts `/decrypt-stream/*` requests
- HTTP 206 range responses work for video seeking
- Decrypt progress bar tracks 0-100%
- Cache management (max 5 entries in SW)

## Solution

Create `tests/web-e2e/tests/streaming-playback.spec.ts` covering:

1. **CTR mode activation** — upload >256KB video, verify SW intercepts requests (check network for `/decrypt-stream/` URLs via `page.route()` or `page.on('request')`)
2. **Playback from start** — video element fires `loadedmetadata` and `canplay` events
3. **Seeking** — programmatically seek to 50%, verify playback continues (no stall/error)
4. **Progress tracking** — decrypt progress bar visible during initial fetch, reaches 100%
5. **GCM fallback** — upload <256KB video, verify blob URL path (no SW interception)
6. **Download button** — click download in player, verify decrypted file downloads

May need to combine with or depend on the media-preview suite for shared setup logic.

title: SDK uploadFile hardcodes GCM — wire CTR encryption for media uploads
area: sdk
files:
  - packages/sdk-core/src/upload/index.ts:88
  - packages/sdk-core/src/upload/index.ts:113
  - packages/sdk/src/client.ts:691
  - apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts:53
  - apps/web/src/hooks/useDropUpload.ts
---

## Problem

The SDK's `uploadFile()` in `packages/sdk-core/src/upload/index.ts` hardcodes `encryptAesGcm` (line 88) and sets `encryptionMode: 'GCM'` (line 113). New file uploads through the SDK always use GCM regardless of file size or MIME type.

The `selectEncryptionMode()` function in `apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts` correctly returns `'CTR'` for media files >256KB, but it's only called for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path in `useDropUpload.ts` — never for new uploads through the SDK.

As a result, the CTR streaming playback pipeline (Service Worker interception, range-request decryption) never activates for newly uploaded files. The decrypt SW works correctly (verified), but files are never encrypted with CTR so `isStreaming` is always false and the encrypted badge never appears.

Discovered during E2E test debugging — the streaming-playback CTR badge test correctly caught this bug.

## Solution

1. Add `encryptionMode` parameter to `sdkCore.uploadFile()` params (already accepted by `createFileMetadata`)
2. When mode is `'CTR'`: use `encryptAesCtr` (already exported from `@cipherbox/crypto`) instead of `encryptAesGcm`, generate CTR IV via `generateCtrIv()`
3. Pass `encryptionMode` through `client.uploadFile()` → `sdkCore.uploadFile()` → `createFileMetadata()`
4. Caller determines mode: either SDK client checks MIME type + size internally, or the web app's `useDropUpload` passes the mode explicitly
5. Remove the `.planning/TODO.md` entry added as a stopgap
6. Un-skip the `streaming-playback.spec.ts` CTR badge test after fix
